# numspot_kubernetes_nodepools (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "numspot_kubernetes_cluster" "kubernetes-cluster" {
  cidr       = "10.20.0.0/16"
  name       = "test-tf-kube"
  profile    = "small"
  version    = "1.33"
  visibility = "EXTERNAL"
}

resource "numspot_kubernetes_nodepool" "kubernetes-np" {
  cluster_id        = numspot_kubernetes_cluster.kubernetes-cluster.id
  name              = "terraform-kubernetes-np-test"
  availability_zone = "eu-west-2c"
  node_profile      = "small"
  replicas          = 3
  autoscaling = {
    min = 1
    max = 1
  }
  root_disk = {
    size = 30
    iops = 1000
    type = "enterprise"
  }
  depends_on = [numspot_kubernetes_cluster.kubernetes-cluster]
}

data "numspot_kubernetes_nodepools" "datasource-nodepools" {
  cluster_id = numspot_kubernetes_cluster.kubernetes-cluster.id
  depends_on = [numspot_kubernetes_nodepool.kubernetes-np]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the Cluster

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `autoscaling_max` (Number) Maximum number of nodes for autoscaling. Present only when autoscaling is enabled.
- `autoscaling_min` (Number) Minimum number of nodes for autoscaling. Present only when autoscaling is enabled.
- `availability_zone` (String) List of all Availability Zones name.
- `id` (String) A string representing uuid.
- `name` (String) A string that inherits rules from StrictSlug: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores, and must start and end with a letter or digit.
- `node_profile` (String) Name of the worker node profile.
Only supported profiles are accepted; the value is validated at the API level.
Supported values: small, medium, large, xlarge, gpu-xsmall, gpu-small,
gpu-medium, gpu-large, gpu-xlarge.
This list is documentation only — the source of truth is the domain registry
(internal/core/domain/node_pools.go, domain.NodeProfiles).
- `replicas` (Number) Current number of replicas, sourced from the MachineDeployment status. Falls back to the creation parameter when the resource status is not yet available.
- `replicas_available` (Number) Current number of replicas in Available status, sourced from the MachineDeployment status. Reports 0 when the resource status is not yet available.
- `root_disk` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--root_disk))
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--status))

<a id="nestedatt--items--root_disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.root_disk`

Read-Only:

- `iops` (Number) The number of IOPS to allocate to the volume.
- `size` (Number) A volume size in GiB
- `type` (String) Types of storage volumes available


<a id="nestedatt--items--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.status`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `reason` (String) Cloud-neutral classification of a failure. Present only when there is a diagnosable reason; the raw provider message is never surfaced.
- `state` (String)
